independence_declaration.statement:
I am code-security-reviewer, session fdd5094e (task T-DG4-REV-SEC-R10). I authored no implementation in the DG4 scope.

Authorship of the round-10 delta:
- the web catalogue text and the tests that pin it are by frontend-ux-engineer (T-DG4-FE-R11);
- the a08 fingerprint narrowing is by backend-workflow-engineer (T-DG4-BE-R7);
- D-137 to D-139 and the freeze are by the delivery-orchestrator.

My only writes are evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/code-security/round-10/ and this record. Builds, static checks and test runs used a disposable, complete clone ($TMPDIR/review-r10, at freeze commit 01a801e), a private copy of the pnpm store and a disposable PostgreSQL. My own scratch mutant test file and its scratch copies of the delivery records were deleted, and the clone's git status was clean afterwards. The validators and candidate.mjs ran read-only in the repository tree.

I formed my verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-10 record, and I have not read one. HEAD stayed at 01a801e for my whole run.

checks_run.command: git clone /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-r10 && git checkout 01a801e && git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG4; git diff --name-only e70ac02 01a801e
checks_run.expected: sha256:f38274cb6d50c49857a89876cec1bc4713f69ef84b29a6f5b9af10061317ccc6 over 1475 files in both trees; not shallow; freeze commit adds only delivery records.
checks_run.actual:
Both the clone and the repository tree give candidate_id sha256:f38274cb…17ccc6 over 1475 files, exit 0. is-shallow-repository = false.

HEAD is 01a801e (the round-10 freeze commit). Its parent is source commit e70ac02. The only files between them are the three round-10 assignments, the candidate manifest f38274cb6d50c498.manifest.json and stages.json, all under docs/delivery. The candidate tree therefore equals source e70ac02.

checks_run.expected: Catalogue value changes plus tests only. No logic, routing or authorization change. No key removed or renamed while something still reads it. en and ar key parity. Every claim the new text makes is true in DG4.

checks_run.command: cd apps/web && npx vitest run src/app/app.test.tsx src/pages/transformations/transformations.test.tsx
checks_run.environment: Clone $TMPDIR/review-r10 at 01a801e, Node 22.22.2, LANG/LC_ALL unset, 1-minute load 10.4-10.7 (three reviewers running)
checks_run.expected: Both files pass, including the new pinning tests in en and ar.
checks_run.actual: 2 files, 49/49 tests pass, exit 0, duration 21.8 s. The log has no failed, skipped or error lines.

checks_run.command: node (patch DELIVERY -> $SEC_DELIVERY and insert secMutate() before the final equality into zz-sec-r10-mutant.test.ts); SEC_MUTANT={none,review-added,stages-removed} tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --project integration tests/qa/integration/zz-sec-r10-mutant.test.ts
checks_run.environment: Clone $TMPDIR/review-r10 at 01a801e, Node 22.22.2, disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 (UTF8, C) on port 26310-26330 range 26300-26399, load 9.8-11.3
checks_run.expected: The set equals g5-g6's, and a missing path is recorded rather than skipped. The before snapshot is taken after submission and before the decision, and the after snapshot after handleGateDecided. A real change to a covered record fails the test, and the control passes.
checks_run.actual:
The set is identical to g5-g6.test.ts:302-309: gates, stages.json, findings.json, reviews, decisions.md and requirements.csv. The add/missing logic matches g5-g6.test.ts:311-323: a missing path gives out[entry]='missing'. Before is taken after the G6 submit (201) and before decideGate. Two guards keep it non-vacuous: it must contain stages.json, findings.json and requirements.csv plus a gates/DGn.json. After is taken after handleGateDecided, the worker consumer. Every other assertion of the test is kept. The whole-tree walk and the LIVE_EVIDENCE exclusion are gone.

BE-R7's evidence: control 31/31 exit 0; the decisions, gate and findings-removed mutants each fail exactly the G6 test (1 failed, 30 passed, exit 1); the handback mutant passes 31/31, out of scope by design.

My own mutants, where exit 1 is by design:
- none: 31/31, exit 0;
- review-added: exit 1. Exactly the G6 test fails with 'expected { …(536) } to deeply equal { …(535) }', so an added file is caught;
- stages-removed: exit 1. Exactly the G6 test fails with '{ …(535) } vs { …(535) }', the value 'missing' against the hash, so a deleted record is caught.
The scratch test file was then removed, and git status of the clone was empty.

The narrowed set drops handbacks, assignments, candidates, runs, test-evidence, environment.md and progress.md. None of these is gate state that a product G6 could be confused with (REQ-S04-008, M0412), so I accept the narrowing. It is the same rule as D-112.

The G6 test 'REQ-S04-008: a product G6 approval (API and its worker consumer) changes nothing under docs/delivery/' took 442 ms. The control run of my mutant harness took 538 ms. D-138 recorded 37.6 s (a timeout) before the fix.

summary:
PASS, with no new findings. Round 10 is a review of the round-9 repairs, and the candidate ID is confirmed on a complete clone.

The product diff from f2ae717 is exactly the nine assigned files.
- FE-R11 changes four catalogue values per language plus their pinning tests. No key is added or removed, en and ar keep key parity, there are no placeholders, the readers are unchanged, and the text's claims are true in DG4.
- BE-R7 narrows the a08 G6 fingerprint to the same DELIVERY_RECORDS set and missing-path rule as g5-g6. Its non-vacuity is confirmed by BE-R7's mutants and by two of my own (an added review file, a deleted stages.json). The a08 file passes 31/31, with the G6 test at 442 ms under load.
- No other test reads docs/delivery wholesale.

D-137 to D-139 hold. Typecheck, build, lint, format, openapi:lint (652 operations) and no-cdn pass, and so do all validators (historical DG3/DG2/DG1, register DG4, pipeline). The other checks are carried forward from round 7 on byte-identical code, each labelled as such.
